parallel_to: autoresearch/objective_weights.json (format autoresearch_primary_objective_policy_v2, UNCHANGED -- still the sole accept/revert signal until this track is explicitly promoted)
comparability: NOT comparable to mcq_mean_option_set_gold_logprob (objective_weights.json v2). The two objectives score different prompts (forced-empty-<think> vs a real generated reasoning trace baked into a closed <think> block) -- never diff the two numbers against each other. See TRACE_EVAL_REASONING_SFT_RLM_PLAN.md assumption 5.

delta_trace_ablation.definition: delta_trace = LL(with_trace) - LL(empty_trace) per item, computed by score_mcq_trace_ll.py (chainlink #108 / I3)
delta_trace_ablation.unlock_condition: delta_trace_positive_fraction > 0.5 (a clear majority) AND the free-form rubric guard stays clean

promotion_gate.rule: TRACE_EVAL_REASONING_SFT_RLM_PLAN.md Part 1 / Plan A step 8: accept this track only when (a) delta_trace > 0 on a clear majority of items, and (b) the free-form rubric guard stays clean. Record the decision here and in program.md's Objective and gate rule section once made -- do not silently flip 'status' above without that record.

rationale: The current primary (objective_weights.json v2) scores P(gold letter | forced-empty-<think> prompt) -- that objective removes reasoning from the scored sequence entirely, so the J-space diagnostic has no verbalizable content to read. This trace-conditioned objective restores a real reasoning surface (Pass 1 generates a genuine trace, Pass 2 scores conditioned on it) without touching the frozen v2 primary, its gate, or any frozen_manifest.json file. See TRACE_EVAL_REASONING_SFT_RLM_PLAN.md Part 1 / Plan A.
